articleTitle: Cardiff School of Engineering: Morgan-Botti Lightning Laboratory
publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Lightning Protection for Aircraft Components
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation is given. The presentation discusses the Morgan-Botti Lightning Laboratory Research Centre, radome lightning protection, and carbon composite materials.

articleTitle: A review of the modelling of CFC for lightning threats to aircraft
publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Lightning Protection for Aircraft Components
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: carbon fibre composite; carbon fibre reinforced plastic; aircraft wing skins; fuselage; EM pulse; conductivity; multilayer representation; thin sheet model; 1D transmission line model; and anisotropic tensors.

articleTitle: Fasteners: Addressing the problem of sparking composite joints: IET Lightning Protection for Aircraft Components Seminar
publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Lightning Protection for Aircraft Components
abstract: In the context of this presentation, a composite structural joint is defined as an interface between two structural components where at least one of those components is a carbon composite material. It presents the reason why we need to protect composite structural joints from lightning.

articleTitle: Exploring lightning susceptibility of composite materials and cable harnesses in aircraft through electromagnetic simulation
publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Lightning Protection for Aircraft Components
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: lightning susceptibility; cable harness modelling; composite material modelling; electromagnetic simulation; lightning transient; carbon fibre; fibreglass mesh; CF filament unit cell model; aircraft materials; anisotropic thin panel; A400M lightning analysis; compact seam model; bidirectional coupling; unidirectional coupling; induced cable signals; and transient surface current.

publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Lightning Protection for Aircraft Components
abstract: Aircraft industry (Civil and Military) is always seeking lower cost development, design and manufacturing solutions for technology and process. The presentation is the research and development trends across a whole aircraft.

articleTitle: Challenges in the lightning protection of composite aircraft ‘TE connectivity’
publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Lightning Protection for Aircraft Components
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: lightning protection; composite aircraft TE connectivity; electromagnetic shielding airframe; CFRP airframe; and electrical structure network.

articleTitle: An insight into aircraft lightning testing techniques
publicationTitle: IET Seminar on Lightning Protection for Aircraft Components
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: aircraft lightning testing techniques; Cobham technical services; E-field test waveforms; Cobham Marx generator; avionic-electrical systems; direct effects generator; direct zoning effects; radome; antennae high voltage impulse testing; full scale aircraft and systems testing; fuel door and pipe gas cell ignition testing; and computer modelling support.
